data.name: Start
data.comment: Button: starts the match clock at 35:00.

data.name: Stop
data.comment: Button: stops the match clock; no more calls.

data.name: Clock
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the minutes and seconds together; focus rests there after Enter or Esc.

data.name: Minutes
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the clock's minutes field.

data.name: Seconds
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the clock's seconds field.

data.name: MinuteMore
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow above the minutes.

data.name: MinuteLess
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow below the minutes.

data.name: SecondMore
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow above the seconds.

data.name: SecondLess
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the arrow below the seconds.
